capabilities: : Render emphasis next to CJK punctuation
: Apply bold, italic, highlight, and strikethrough styling
: Neutralize excess styling from the parser
: Rewrite source Markdown for cross-platform compatibility
extras: The plugin is theme agnostic and never modifies the note text.
intentEvidence: Render bold and italic next to CJK punctuation in Obsidian Live Preview.
problem: CommonMark parsers fail when emphasis markers (like `**`) are adjacent to CJK punctuation (like `。`), causing the markers to render literally instead of applying bold/italic styling.

relations.evidence: obsidian-cjk-bold-fix — an earlier plugin that patches the same Live Preview behaviour; this project adds source-level rewriting and code/math masking
markdown-cjk-friendly — a spec-level fix for CJK emphasis

summary: A formatter that fixes CommonMark parsing issues by rendering bold and italic emphasis correctly next to CJK punctuation in Live Preview and rewriting source code.
